## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check:governance`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Exact head SHA recorded
- [ ] No credentials or credential values included
- [ ] No deployment or live mutation claimed without evidence

## Evidence

Provide commands, results, before-and-after state, and resource identities required
by the work packet. Do not include secrets.

## Risk and rollback

State the risk class, rollback method, and whether any live system was changed.
